summary: BioMarin filed an 8-K on Sept 30, 2026, disclosing a Sept 24 Settlement and License Agreement with Ascendis Pharma A/S. BioMarin grants Ascendis a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-bearing license to certain patent rights covering TransCon CNP (navepegritide/Yuviwel). Ascendis pays 20% royalties on U.S. net sales and 18% on EU, Brazil, and South Korea net sales from first commercial sale until May 2030. All related litigation will be dismissed with prejudice. This is an IP cross-license settlement, not a special situation. Watch commercialization timing and royalty flows.
